definitions.axis_accuracy: chart-level valid-axis rate: numeric/value axes require >=2 ticks and >=2 pixels; text/category axes require >=1 tick and >=1 pixel; denominator is all GT charts in scope
definitions.tick_value_mae: mean absolute error over comparable numeric GT tick positions; missing/non-numeric predictions are excluded from MAE but counted incorrect for accuracy
definitions.tick_value_accuracy: tick-level exact-match accuracy over all GT ticks; missing predictions count as incorrect
definitions.legend_color_accuracy_flexible: color exact-match accuracy; name-aligned when possible, with single-series/same-position fallback
definitions.legend_label_accuracy: exact normalized GT series_color name match against predicted colors[].name
definitions.legend_color_nearest_palette_accuracy: Recommended legend/color metric: match predicted color to the object/series (point charts use data_points labels when series_color keys are auxiliary labels), then count success if the nearest color in that chart GT palette is the correct GT color.
definitions.legend_color_exact_accuracy_corrected_ma: Diagnostic exact-hex color accuracy after corrected object/series matching; lower because MLLM colors are often visually close but not exact hex.
definitions.corrected_label_exact_accuracy: Corrected label-name metric: point charts use data_points object names when series_color keys are auxiliary color labels; series charts use series/legend names. Exact normalized match.
definitions.evaluable_label_exact_accuracy: Recommended label-name metric for legend/object labels: same corrected GT, but excludes single-series v_bar/h_bar generic fallback cases because no real legend label was extracted or needed.
definitions.evaluable_label_relaxed_accuracy: Same as evaluable_label_exact_accuracy, with minor whitespace/hyphen/split-word normalization for OCR-like legend text variants.
definitions.point_label_name_accuracy: Label-name accuracy is evaluated only for scatter and bubble object labels. GT labels come from data_points object names; exact match after whitespace/case normalization.
definitions.text_axis_accuracy: Accuracy over GT text/categorical axis tick labels only. It counts exact normalized matches of text ticks; numeric axes are excluded.

color_metric_audit.note: Previous legend_color_accuracy_flexible was exact-hex and used series_color keys as labels for point charts. That is invalid for bubble samples where data_points labels differ from series_color keys, and too strict for anti-aliased/transparent colors.

label_metric_audit.note: Updated: label-name accuracy is only reported for scatter/bubble object labels. Bar/line legend names are excluded from this metric; text/categorical axes are reported separately as text_axis_accuracy.
